DOM-01-S17.title: When the history fits in the context window, putting all of it in beats every memory tested
DOM-01-S17.prediction: On LongMemEval histories that fit the answer model's window, putting the whole history in will again beat plain retrieval and both fact-extracting memories.
DOM-01-S17.breaks_if: Any memory system's interval against the whole history is entirely above zero on histories that fit the window.
DOM-01-S17.note: Valid only if every conversation fits the answer model's context window: check 'Largest prompt' for fullcontext against your model's limit.

DOM-01-S5.title: Adding keyword search to vector retrieval gave no gain on LoCoMo
DOM-01-S5.prediction: Adding keyword fusion to vector retrieval will also show no gain on other conversational English benchmarks such as LongMemEval.
DOM-01-S5.breaks_if: A pre-registered run on another conversational benchmark gives an interval for hybrid against vector only that lies entirely above zero.
DOM-01-S5.note: Hybrid is Narva's I3 setting: BM25 and vector fused by reciprocal rank (k=60, 50 candidates each).

DOM-01-S16.title: Both fact-extracting memories lost to plain retrieval under one protocol
DOM-01-S16.prediction: On longer conversation benchmarks such as LongMemEval, Mem0 open source and Graphiti will again answer fewer questions than plain retrieval over raw turns under the same protocol.
DOM-01-S16.breaks_if: A pre-registered run on a longer benchmark gives either system an interval against plain retrieval that lies entirely above zero.
DOM-01-S16.note: Pass your fact-extracting memory with --system; Narva measured Mem0 open source and Graphiti this way.

DOM-01-S18.title: Mem0 open source dates extracted facts by the day of ingest
DOM-01-S18.prediction: Any Mem0 open-source version whose add() still leaves the Observation Date at the ingest day will date facts from imported history by the day of ingest.
DOM-01-S18.breaks_if: Such a version answers time questions on imported history with no answers naming the ingest year.
DOM-01-S18.note: Ingest past conversations into your memory and ask time questions; a year in no session date (often the year you ingested) is the defect Narva found in Mem0 open source.

DOM-01-S6.title: Single LoCoMo runs are noisy even at temperature 0
DOM-01-S6.prediction: Repeat passes of any configuration on LoCoMo will disagree on some verdicts, so single-run gaps of a few points between systems will not survive paired intervals.
DOM-01-S6.breaks_if: A repeat pass of a configuration agrees on every verdict.
DOM-01-S6.note: Two passes of the same configuration, same models, temperature 0; the share of matching verdicts shows how noisy a single run is.
